indicator_definition: Proportion of the population living in overcrowded dwellings (too few rooms relative to household size), expressed as a percentage. Reflects inadequate housing, especially in urban areas. Data collected through EU-SILC.
rationale: Overcrowding affects health and quality of life. Progress means a sustained reduction in the proportion living in overcrowded dwellings.
methodology_characteristics: Data collected through EU-SILC using a standardised room-to-person ratio definition. Published annually by Eurostat.
